findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_package" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_account" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_account · Private data: get_contact_and_support, search_site_content, request_account · Public sink: request_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_account · Private data: get_contact_and_support, search_site_content, request_account · Public sink: request_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
